answer: Random paid attestation turns trust into a lottery an attacker cannot rig cheaply. Each new agent is examined through a prism of randomly drawn, unrelated reviewers who must stake coins on their verdict; a wrong verdict forfeits the stake. A Sybil farm looks like an oasis of cheap identities, but to pass it must corrupt or outnumber a fresh random sample every time, like trying to buy every reef in a shifting sea. Honest reviewers profit, cheaters bleed stake, and mass fakery becomes unprofitable.
